title: LLM Whisperer: An Inconspicuous Attack to Bias LLM Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the absolute improvement in the likelihood of an LLM recommending or mentioning a specific target brand within the first 64 tokens of its response when the input prompt is subtly manipulated using synonym replacements or paraphrasing.

Evaluating the shift in probability of an LLM favoring a specific target concept (e.g., a nation, political party, or candidate) in responses to societal and historical topics when provided with adversarially perturbed prompts.
